LM_Graumans.findings: Opened1927; pagoda roof, large columns with iron masks, stone Heaven Dogs. Historic1927 photographs and reproduced architectural records establish forecourt/pagoda forms. Original colours documented as coral columns, blue/gold dragon surround, oxidized copper and yellow-green plaster. Required82x58x16m mass is a deliberate compressed stylization of the taller real theatre.
LM_Graumans.reference_use: Visual research only; no historical photograph is a runtime texture.

LM_BrownDerby.findings: Vine Street restaurant opened February1929, Spanish Revival facade with a small hat-shaped roof sign; the building was rectangular. MONA's entry dates the sign1929 while its narrative says early1930s. Deliver an original period interpretation of the required sign, not a later white/yellow restoration facsimile.

LM_PoliceStation.findings: New Wilcox police station and receiving hospital opened March1930. City historic report identifies the police station as Renaissance Revival, architect Peter K. Schabarum. The1936 exterior reference shows a symmetrical civic front, upper window grid, central arched entrance and flagpole. Adapt brick/cream stone per work-order brief.
